question: Should Telegram suppress all compaction/system-marked notices, or should it preserve the current documented `notifyUser` and command/status reply delivery contract while only suppressing a narrower unwanted notice class?
rationale: The code can be repaired mechanically only after maintainers choose the delivery policy boundary, because the proposed suppression conflicts with documented opt-in compaction notices and existing system-marked visible replies.

options.title: Preserve Current Delivery Contract
options.body: Keep `notifyUser` compaction notices and system-marked command/status replies deliverable, and require any Telegram suppression to use typed/narrow notice metadata.

options.title: Change Telegram Notice Policy
options.body: Accept broad suppression only with explicit docs/config policy updates and upgrade proof showing existing users will not lose expected feedback silently.

options.title: Pause Or Close Direction
options.body: Pause this branch if the intended notice class cannot be defined without replacing most of the current patch.

recommendation.title: Preserve Current Delivery Contract
recommendation.body: Keep `notifyUser` compaction notices and system-marked command/status replies deliverable, and require any Telegram suppression to use typed/narrow notice metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows broad ownership across the affected Telegram outbound, compaction notice, docs, and system-message surfaces.
